_meta: DRAFT — NOT YET IMPORTED (wired automatically by the gen-slices auto-loader). AF lead-chase round, 2026-08-13, follow-up to AF/G.23. Target was São Tomé's Lei n.º 16/92 (Lei das Finanças Locais), previously flagged as an open lead in st-g23-municipal.json's _dropped block. This round confirmed the law's title/date/gazette-locator via a government-authored INDEX entry (São Tomé's own Assembleia Nacional documentation service, third-party hosted on asg-plp.org) but still could NOT locate the statute's own primary text — see the corresponding UPDATE note on st-principe-lei10-2022 in af-sao-tome-principe.json. No node minted here: an index/summary citation (title + date + gazette locator only) is not primary legal text, and this corpus's evidence standard requires the document itself, not a description of it. Also resolves two side-leads from AF/G.23: leginon.dgrn.gov.st is confirmed unrelated (civil-registry portal, not legislative) and retired from future search lists; dre.gov.st (the nominal official gazette) is confirmed TLS-broken, presenting a certificate for an unrelated commercial entity (abagroup.st) — flagged as a dead/compromised-looking government domain worth periodic re-checking.

_dropped.edge: st-principe-lei10-2022 cites Lei n.º 16/92 (Lei de Finanças Locais) — primary text
_dropped.why: Full text of Lei n.º 16/92, de 31 de Dezembro de 1992 ("Lei das Finanças Locais", DR n.º 27) remains unlocatable despite a dedicated lead-chase round. Checked this round: leginon.dgrn.gov.st (confirmed to be São Tomé's DGRN civil-registry vital-events/identity-document validation portal — "legi nón" is Creole Forro for "our root," unrelated to "lei"/law — not a legislative database at all; retired as a lead, see the separate _dropped note below); dgrn.gov.st/Legislacao.php (reached, but no 1992-era laws present in its listing); dre.gov.st (the nominal official gazette; TLS certificate mismatch, presenting a cert for an unrelated commercial entity, abagroup.st — could not be checked, see separate _dropped note below); FAOLEX (no coverage of this instrument); two academic papers on São Tomé local government/finance (neither covers Lei 16/92 specifically); and the Assembleia Nacional's b-software.st-hosted portal (has a "Legislação" menu present, but no searchable law-by-number database could be found within it this round). The one substantive result: a government-authored INDEX entry — São Tomé's own Assembleia Nacional documentation service (Direcção de Serviços de Apoio Parlamentar e Documentação, DSAPD/DDIP), dated Setembro 2007, in its "Sumário das Legislações Publicadas nos Diários da República: 1975-2007" (section "Impostos"), hosted third-party on asg-plp.org (Associação dos Secretários-Gerais dos Parlamentos de Língua Portuguesa): "Lei n.º16/92, de 31 de Dezembro de 1992, DR. n.º 27. - Lei das Finanças Locais." This confirms title, date and gazette locator, and situates the law as the capstone of a coordinated December 1992 legislative package (Lei 10/92 autarquias framework, Lei 11/92 autarquia-body electoral law, Lei 12/92 electoral rolls, Lei 15/92 tax-legislation authorization, Lei 16/92 this finance law, Lei 17/92 the 1993 state budget) — but it is an index/summary entry only, not the statute's own primary legal text, so no node is minted. This UPDATE has instead been folded into st-principe-lei10-2022's description in af-sao-tome-principe.json. `backstp.gov.st` was also noted as a live Strapi CMS backend that MIGHT power a legislative archive — unconfirmed this round, a lead worth a future round with headless-browser/JS-execution tooling to probe its API for a law-by-number search.

_dropped.edge: leginon.dgrn.gov.st as a legislative database lead
_dropped.why: RETIRED — confirmed this round to NOT be a legislative database at all. leginon.dgrn.gov.st is São Tomé's DGRN (Direcção-Geral dos Registos e Notariado) civil-registry vital-events/identity-document validation portal; "legi nón" is Creole Forro for "our root" (a civil-registry/identity theme), not a truncation or variant of "lei"/law. This lead was carried into this round from AF/G.23's st-g23-municipal.json _dropped note (which had flagged it as JS-rendered with no extractable static text and guessed API endpoints all 404ing); this round's finding supersedes that note by explaining WHY it was unproductive — it was never the right kind of site. Recorded so no future round re-spends effort probing it as a legislative source.

_dropped.edge: dre.gov.st as the official gazette host
_dropped.why: dre.gov.st, São Tomé's nominal official Diário da República gazette site, is currently unreachable over a valid TLS connection: the certificate presented does not match the domain and instead identifies an unrelated commercial entity (abagroup.st). This corroborates st-oge-2026's existing hosting caveat in st-g23-municipal.json ("the official host dre.gov.st returned a TLS certificate-hostname-mismatch error and could not be independently checked this round"). Flagged as a dead or possibly compromised-looking government domain, worth a periodic re-check in future rounds rather than repeated per-round investigation — if it comes back online with a valid certificate it would be the single best lead for locating Lei n.º 16/92 and other pre-2000s legislation by DR issue number (this law is DR n.º 27, 1992).
